description:
The Rove has been developed from a strong desire for travel. A bike that will give you the ability to be truly free, not limited by performance, tyre size or luggage carrying ability. With geometry based around flat bars and mountain bike components to inspire confidence and resilience in the toughest of conditions. Available in a wide range or sizes to suit everyone; the smallest of which utilises 27.5" wheels to improve manoeuvrability, while the larger sizes take advantage of the smooth rolling characteristics 29" wheels have to offer.

The frame has a full array of mounts with the ability to fit mudguards, traditional front and rear panniers, three bottles, and there are additional cage mounts on the forks. As with many Spa Cycles frames, the Rove is available in super-dependable Reynolds 725 steel (from March 2023), or 3Al2.5V Titanium if you desire the ultimate off-road adventure machine. We also offer a specially-designed steel fork with full mudguard and luggage capacity.

If you truly have the urge to ride without limits the Rove should be at the top of your kit list!

Frame - 3Al/2.5V titanium straight gauge seamless tubing
Bright brush finish with sandblast graphics

Forks - Spa Cycles Rove (Boost 15x110mm Thru Axle) Full Carbon Fork with post-mount caliper fitting.
Rear Axle - Boost 12x148mm Thru Axle.

Price includes frame and forks. The frame's headtube and BB shell will be faced. Headset not included (Recommended headset: FSA Orbit ITA). The headset will be fitted if purchased with the frameset.
